code='''def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the largest connected colored object with the color of the line marker.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v==c for row in grid for v in row))
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for a,b in ((y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)):
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==col:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    # marker is the most prevalent color among components consisting of a straight run
    # or joined perpendicular runs; choose color with the most pixels in such components.
    scores={}
    for col,cells in comps:
        if len(cells)>=3:
            ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
            if len(set(ys))==1 or len(set(xs))==1: scores[col]=scores.get(col,0)+len(cells)
    marker=max(scores,key=scores.get) if scores else None
    candidates=[(col,cells) for col,cells in comps if col!=marker]
    if candidates:
        col,cells=max(candidates,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=marker
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
